results.title: Open-source CubeSat MBSE Approach to Address Traceability: Power Subsystem
results.abstract: The benefits of using Model-based System Engineering (MBSE) approaches for the development of projects go beyond just replacing document-centric methods. MBSE is expected to aid in the ability to manage complexity and capture knowledge. By using MBSE approaches on CubeSats this paper aims to address notions of traceability and how system models can be used to verify the fulfillment of requirements...
